facts.accepted_meaning: Main checks the literal unarchived FileTest existence of Data/messages_core.dat before calling the default-baseline loader; then runs plugins, Compiler.main, Game.initialize and Game.set_up_system in that order. Hangup caught around this whole sequence prints only outside debug, calls emergency save and reraises.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: No Scripts.rxdata decoding/engine startup loader is defined in Main; do not infer its binary payload or engine ordering from this file.

facts.accepted_meaning: Translation gathering inflates every $RGSS_SCRIPTS script[2]. Only when the array length equals one does it additionally read every path returned by Dir.all(Data/Scripts); that traversal does not filter by .rb extension here. Existing PluginScripts.rxdata is loaded and each plugin[2] script[1] inflated as UTF-8. Collected script strings are installed before common-event loading and before map-event collection.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: The literal $RGSS_SCRIPTS and the binary Scripts.rxdata payload were not enumerated by this contribution. Load/decompression/ordinary type or I/O failures propagate; only Hangup is swallowed by gather, so a prefix of previously installed buckets/maps can survive and compile_all may proceed to save it.

facts.accepted_meaning: Extractor scans literal double-quoted _INTL/_ISPRINTF in script text and _I in event-script text with the shown regex families. extract_text loads a separate Translation for the selected language, obtains default-core or default-game baseline, and returns after disposing its message window if that baseline is empty. An occupied destination asks confirmation before deleting files; refusal disposes and returns. Accepted extraction deletes every Dir.all destination file before writing replacement files incrementally.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: This is lexical extraction, not Ruby execution or all possible runtime translations. The source has no transaction/rollback for deletion or later output failure. Numbered arrays emit numeric key, original text and chosen translation; hashes emit normalized key and chosen translation. Missing/false translation selects original; empty string is truthy and emitted.

facts.accepted_meaning: compile_text opens Data/messages_<dat_filename>.dat in wb before directory discovery or parsing. It compiles all discovered *.txt files into a local all_text then Marshal.dumps; ensure closes output, but no temporary replacement or restoration exists. compile_text_from_file validates section names and first-key-selected array/hash record widths before installing each completed section into all_text; an existing section merges truthy incoming values.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: A parse/lookup/read failure can leave the previously existing output already truncated. A section parse failure does not install that section yet, but preceding sections in all_text are retained locally. File close is ensured; success messages and disposal occur only after success. No business execution performed.

facts.accepted_meaning: Translation initializes four independent stores to nil: default-core/default-game baselines and current-core/current-game selected language. load_message_files first clears both current stores, loads only Data/messages_<language>_core.dat and _game.dat when literal FileTest says present, accepts only an outer Array, and rescues ordinary exceptions by clearing both current stores. Default loading is lazy and cached whenever default-core is truthy; it reads default files via pbRgssOpen+Marshal.load, coerces non-array/missing stores to [], and on ordinary failure sets both defaults to [].
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: No inner bucket/key/value validation or complete serialized-bucket inventory follows from outer Array checking. A game-file failure discards a core translation already read in that call. A [] baseline is truthy and blocks subsequent automatic default reload. The resource abstraction implementation and binary bodies are not independently accepted here.

facts.accepted_meaning: Default saving opens and dumps default-core first and default-game second to literal wb files. set replaces a default-game bucket; add starts from its prior default-game bucket. Positional additions omit nil/empty input or input equal to the corresponding default-core entry. Hash additions normalize incoming keys and omit keys present in default-core; they do not compare translated values. Event maps use per-map hash buckets and initialize missing baseline containers as a side effect.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: Core write may succeed while game write fails; no rollback or cancellation branch exists in save_default_messages. These APIs mutate baselines, not current selected-language runtime stores. Marshal encodability and all actual binary values remain caller prerequisites.

facts.accepted_meaning: Runtime numeric get checks current-game then current-core and returns empty string on a miss. Hash get normalizes the source key, returns the original source string for empty key or complete miss, and checks current-game before current-core. Map get checks current-game map ID, current-game common-map 0, current-core map ID, then current-core map 0. Each branch tests Ruby truthiness, so an empty string is a hit.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: Default baselines are not a runtime fallback in these methods. Current data bucket/index operations may raise on an inner malformed shape; direct pbGetMessage wrappers do not rescue that. delayed_load_message_files loads at most the filename-held delayed request and clears @filename afterwards; it does not automatically load defaults.

facts.accepted_meaning: MessageTypes exposes fixed compatibility IDs 0..30, in order EVENT_TEXTS, SPECIES_NAMES, SPECIES_CATEGORIES, POKEDEX_ENTRIES, SPECIES_FORM_NAMES, MOVE_NAMES, MOVE_DESCRIPTIONS, ITEM_NAMES, ITEM_NAME_PLURALS, ITEM_DESCRIPTIONS, ABILITY_NAMES, ABILITY_DESCRIPTIONS, TYPE_NAMES, TRAINER_TYPE_NAMES, TRAINER_NAMES, FRONTIER_INTRO_SPEECHES, FRONTIER_END_SPEECHES_WIN, FRONTIER_END_SPEECHES_LOSE, REGION_NAMES, REGION_LOCATION_NAMES, REGION_LOCATION_DESCRIPTIONS, MAP_NAMES, PHONE_MESSAGES, TRAINER_SPEECHES_LOSE, SCRIPT_TEXTS, RIBBON_NAMES, RIBBON_DESCRIPTIONS, STORAGE_CREATOR_NAME, ITEM_PORTION_NAMES, ITEM_PORTION_NAME_PLURALS, POKEMON_NICKNAMES. One class-held Translation instance services its wrappers.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: These IDs describe the source API. They do not prove any frozen .dat contains all 31 buckets or all possible keys, nor that every ID has a live caller.

facts.accepted_meaning: _INTL and _ISPRINTF rescue only the lookup step and fall back to arg[0], then clone and perform ordered placeholder substitution. _INTL substitutes {n}; _ISPRINTF substitutes {n:format} through sprintf. _I takes the current map ID and delegates to _MAPINTL. Both explicit map formatters perform lookup without the lookup rescue used by the script formatters.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: Clone/substitution/format errors occur outside the script-lookup rescue. Earlier placeholder substitutions can affect later passes. No display is performed by these formatters; their callers decide timing and state changes.

facts.accepted_meaning: compile_all(false) returns before gather/save. compile_all(true) first compiles PBS, animations and trainer events, then gathers script/event text, sequentially saves default messages, and calls cached default loading if core literal file exists. There is no current-language reload in this sequence.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: Ordinary failure in any earlier compile stage prevents subsequent gather/save; prior registry/file writes are not rolled back. Swallowed gather Hangup can yield a saved prefix. Cached default loading after save does not prove a disk reload because default-core may already be truthy.

facts.accepted_meaning: Game.set_up_system adapts an existing save or uses {}, chooses boot initialization versus boot-value load by adapted hash emptiness, sets resize, and when LANGUAGES is nonempty selects language only for empty data with at least two entries then directly indexes the configured entry to load its second component as current-language filename.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: No configured-language count/index/inner-shape repair is performed here. A nonempty adapted save skips chooser. Current-language files can be missing and yield nil stores with source-string/empty numeric fallback; a bad configured index can fail before the loader.

facts.accepted_meaning: Metadata compilation registers validated global/player records, checks required global 0 and player 1, and installs the storage creator baseline string as a hash bucket. Map metadata final validation collects real map names into a hash-style translation bucket.
facts.premises_failure_and_limits: Only these concrete producer units are accepted by this contribution. All other PBS translation producer buckets, gameplay display callers and serialized payload keys remain outside this limited handoff until separately received.
